title: Sabiá: Portuguese Large Language Models
summary: Ramon Pires, Hugo Abonizio, Thales Sales Almeida and Rodrigo Nogueira submitted Sabiá: Portuguese Large Language Models to arXiv on April 16, 2023. The paper documents language models produced by further pretraining GPT-J and LLaMA models on Portuguese texts and evaluates them on Portuguese-language datasets.
significance: A documented Portuguese-language-model research milestone focused on language-specific continued pretraining and evaluation.

verification.note: Title, authors, April 16 2023 v1 submission date, Portuguese-text continued-pretraining method and Portuguese evaluation claims are supported by the original arXiv record. The record does not infer a model birth date, development geography, ancestry, influence or causality beyond what the paper explicitly states.
